_doc: AI difficulty knobs (PLAN §8). Stream A ships a minimal AI for M1 (js/sim/ai/index.js reads reaction, greed, noise, micro); stream E extends this file and the AI in M6. reaction = ticks between decisions; greed = [min,max] share of gold put into sends at each decision after a Pay; noise = random jitter on send scores (0 = always the best-scored unit); micro 0/1/2 = hero play tier; retreatAt = HP share at which the hero walks home.
